verdict.rationale: Period locking is a fair axis for accounting software like QuickBooks Online, but the evidence pack never mentions a closing date, period lock, or reopening control. The nearest items are custom roles and permissions and backup/restore to undo mistakes. These are adjacent controls, not a lock that stops prior-period changes until a period is explicitly reopened.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can lock closed periods so prior-period numbers cannot change without an explicit reopening
